properties.query:
SecurityAlert
      | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
      | where AlertSeverity in ("High", "Medium")
      | summarize count() by AlertName, AlertSeverity
      | order by count_ desc

SigninLogs
      | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
      | where ResultType != 0
      | summarize FailedAttempts = count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
      | where FailedAttempts > 5
      | order by FailedAttempts desc

properties.displayName: High Number of Failed Authentication Attempts
properties.description: Triggers when there are more than 10 failed authentication attempts in 5 minutes

allOf.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 | summarize count() by Computer | where count_ > 10

properties.description: Triggers when unusual network patterns are detected

allOf.query: AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL | where FlowType_s == "MaliciousFlow" | summarize count() | where count_ > 0

properties.description: Triggers when CPU usage exceeds 90% for 15 minutes

allOf.query: Perf | where CounterName == "% Processor Time" | summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer | where avg_CounterValue > 90

properties.description: Triggers when memory usage exceeds 90% for 15 minutes

allOf.query: Perf | where CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use" | summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer | where avg_CounterValue > 90

properties.description: Triggers when unusual Key Vault access patterns are detected

allOf.query: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT" | where ResultType != "Success" | summarize count() | where count_ > 5

properties.description: Triggers when unusual storage access patterns are detected

allOf.query: StorageBlobLogs | where StatusCode >= 400 | summarize count() | where count_ > 100

properties.description: Triggers when service availability drops below 99.9%

allOf.query: AzureMetrics | where MetricName == "Availability" | summarize avg(Average) | where avg_Average < 99.9

properties.description: Triggers when daily cost increases by more than 50% compared to previous day

allOf.query: Usage | summarize sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | extend PrevDay = prev(sum_Quantity, 1) | where sum_Quantity > PrevDay * 1.5
